DECLARE @DATE DATE = '{7}'
SELECT TOP 500 H.DOCTYP [SRCTYP] ,H.DOCNUM [SRCDOC] ,S.DOCLIN [SRCLIN] ,H.DOCNUM + '-' + Cast(S.DOCLIN AS VARCHAR) PORKEY ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(16), H.DOCDAT, 23) DOCDAT ,H.DOCDES ,H.PRJNUM ,H.SITE ,SITEDES.SITENAM SITEDES ,H.BPSNO ,BPS.BPSNAM ,BPS1.BPSNAM SITETRANAM ,S.ITMNO ,ITM.ITMNAM + ITM.ITMNAM1 + ITM.ITMNAM2 ITMNAM ,ITM.ITMSPEC ,ITM.ITMSIZE ,S.ITMVER ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(16), S.REQDAT, 23) REQDAT ,S.STU --库存单位 ,Iif(ITM.TCLCOD = 'FIBER', ITM.PCU, S.UOM) UOM --采购单位 ,S.UOMCOE --换算系数 ,S.QTYSTU - Isnull(PBO.QTYSTU, 0) QTYSTU --库存单位数量 ,Isnull(PBO.QTYSTU, 0) PBOQTYSTU ,Isnull(PBO.QTY, 0) PBOQTY ,S.IVATTYP ,S.PRCQTYSTU ,S.PRTQTYSTU ,S.NETPRI SHOWPORNETPRI --订单无税单价 ,H.CUR PORCUR ,'{6}' PBPCUR --,S.NETPRI AS PORNETPRI --订单无税单价 --,S.NETPRI --无税单价 --,S.GROPRI --含税单价 ,R.CURRAT ,CAST(S.NETPRI * R.CALRAT AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS PORNETPRI --换算后的订单无税单价 ,CAST(S.NETPRI * 1.02 * R.CALRAT AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS NETPRI --换算后的无税单价 ,CAST(S.NETPRI * 1.02 * R.CALRAT AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS GROPRI --换算后的含税单价 --,S.TAXRT --税率 --,S.NETAMT --无税金额 --,S.GRPAMT --含税金额 --,S.TAXAMT --税额 ,0 AS TAXRT --税率 ,CAST(ROUND(S.NETPRI*1.02*R.CALRAT, 2) * (S.QTYSTU-Isnull(PBO.QTYSTU, 0)) AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS NETAMT --无税金额 ,CAST(ROUND(S.NETPRI*1.02*R.CALRAT, 2) * (S.QTYSTU-Isnull(PBO.QTYSTU, 0)) AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS GRPAMT --含税金额 ,0 AS TAXAMT --税额 ,H.CONTNOI --百隆合同号 ,H.CONTNOE --合同号 ,H.CONTDES ,S.SRCTYP ORITYP ,S.SRCDOC ORIDOC ,S.SRCLIN ORILIN ,S.FAC ,N'货币转换' CHAREA FROM PORDER H INNER JOIN PORDLIN S ON H.DOCNUM = S.DOCNUM OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 ISNULL(CR.CURRAT, 1) AS CURRAT , CASE WHEN CR.CUR = H.CUR THEN CR.CURRAT WHEN CR.CUR = '{6}' THEN 1.0 / CR.CURRAT ELSE 1.0 END AS CALRAT FROM (SELECT H.CUR AS SRC, '{6}' AS DES) PP LEFT JOIN CURRAT CR ON (CR.CUR = PP.SRC AND CR.DESCUR = PP.DES) OR (CR.CUR = PP.DES AND CR.DESCUR = PP.SRC) WHERE RATDAT <= @DATE AND (PP.SRC = PP.DES OR CR.CUR IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY RATDAT DESC, CRETIM DESC) R INNER JOIN BPSUP BPS ON H.BPSNO = BPS.BPSNO INNER JOIN BPSUP BPS1 ON H.SITETRA = BPS1.BPSNO INNER JOIN ITM ON ITM.ITMNO = S.ITMNO LEFT JOIN LINKOPT DOCSTA ON DOCSTA.OPTID = H.DOCSTA AND DOCSTA.OPTTYP = 'DOCSTA' LEFT JOIN LINKOPT LDOCSTA ON LDOCSTA.OPTID = S.DOCSTA AND LDOCSTA.OPTTYP = 'DOCSTA' LEFT JOIN LINKOPT WFLSTA ON WFLSTA.OPTID = H.WFLSTA AND WFLSTA.OPTTYP = 'WFLSTA' LEFT JOIN LINKOPT IVATTYP ON IVATTYP.OPTID = S.IVATTYP AND IVATTYP.OPTTYP = 'IVATTYP' LEFT JOIN LINKOPT DOCGRP ON DOCGRP.OPTID = H.DOCGRP AND DOCGRP.OPTTYP = 'DOCGRP' AND DOCGRP.LINKOPTID = 'POH' LEFT JOIN ENTSITE SITEDES ON SITEDES.SITE = H.SITE LEFT JOIN (SELECT SRCDOC,SRCLIN,Sum(QTYSTU) QTYSTU,Sum(QTY) QTY FROM PBOLD GROUP BY SRCDOC,SRCLIN) PBO ON PBO.SRCDOC = S.DOCNUM AND PBO.SRCLIN = S.DOCLIN WHERE S.DOCSTA = '2' AND ( ITM.TCLCOD = 'FIBER' OR S.QTYSTU - Isnull(PBO.QTYSTU, 0) > 0 ) --纤维原料提单数量会超订单数不做控制 AND H.SITE LIKE '%{0}%' AND H.SITETRA = '{1}' AND H.CONTNOI + H.CONTNOE + H.DOCNUM LIKE '%{2}%' AND S.ITMNO LIKE '%{3}%' AND S.ITMVER LIKE '%{4}%' AND H.DOCNUM + ITM.ITMNAM + ITM.ITMNAM1 + ITM.ITMNAM2 + ITM.ITMSPEC + ITM.ITMSIZE LIKE '%{5}%' ORDER BY S.DOCNUM, S.DOCLIN
